instruction.thesis: The PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH contrarian long thesis required the elevated P/C ratio (1.465) to resolve as put-heavy positioning unwinds and spot recovers. However, oil_wti_spot has declined from the entry baseline of $96.93 to $96.20 (-0.75%), approaching the 2% stop level, and the oil_cl_pc_ratio has not moved (still 1.465) — the signal has not repriced. With macro composite now BEARISH and oil macro signal 'DECLINING' with only 33% probability of settling above current, the contrarian thesis is not gaining traction. The position is at -0.82% P&L and the stop is at -2%; closing now to preserve capital rather than wait for mechanical stop given the deteriorating macro backdrop and lack of signal evidence improvement.
